footer.text: Order directly from the store via WhatsApp or a quick call.

home.title: No store selected
home.subtitle: Open a store's link to browse its products and place an order.

store.contactMessage: Hi {{store}}, I have a question about your products.

welcome.title: Welcome to {{store}}
welcome.subtitle: Unlocking the catalogue on this device...

gate.requestMessage: Hi {{store}}, could you send me a new link to your catalogue?
gate.browserNote: Your link is remembered on this browser only. A private window, another phone, or clearing your browser data will need a new link.
gate.footerNote: Only {{store}} can hand out access to this catalogue.

locked.title: You need an invitation
locked.body: {{store}} shares this catalogue with invited customers only. Ask them for your personal link and it will open right here.

already_used.title: This link is already in use
already_used.body: An invitation opens on one device and stays there. This one was opened somewhere else, so ask {{store}} for a fresh link.

expired.title: This link has expired
expired.body: Invitations do not stay open forever. Ask {{store}} to send you a new one — it only takes a moment.

revoked.title: This link is no longer valid
revoked.body: {{store}} replaced or cancelled this invitation. The newest link they sent you is the one that works.

blocked.title: Access is paused
blocked.body: {{store}} has paused access for your number. Get in touch with them to sort it out.

invalid.title: We could not read this link
invalid.body: It may have been cut short when it was copied. Ask {{store}} to send the link again and open it directly from the message.

rate_limited.title: Too many attempts
rate_limited.body: Please wait a few minutes and open your link again, or ask {{store}} for help.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: We could not open this link just now. Please try again, or ask {{store}} for a new one.

product.ordersNote: Orders are placed directly with the store via WhatsApp or phone.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.subtitle: We couldn't find what you were looking for.
